title: Balanced Prompt Adaptation against Entropy-Induced Collapse for Test-Time Binary Segmentation (BAPA)
mechanism: The paper proves that entropy minimisation collapses imbalanced binary segmentation toward the majority class. The fix uses class-balanced high-confidence anchors with equal total loss per class and updates only the prompts.
adaptation: The VLM prompt part does not apply to our CNN. The CBA rule does: every self-training TTA arm must select crack anchors separately and give crack equal total loss weight to background.
min_experiment: Ablation inside rows 3, 8 and 9: class-balanced anchors on vs off. Kill if E1 crack recall differs by < +0.02.
evidence: R: theory of entropy-induced collapse in a shared-shift model. BAPA has the highest mean Dice across four domains and improves zero-shot Dice on all four datasets.
prior_overlap: None. Tent was dropped without a run; this paper gives the reason entropy TTA would fail on crack and a fix.
